understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each BP35 level, avoid spikes, and continue until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each level provides 2 attempts of up to 50 turns. MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally when possible; gravity is currently DOWN and causes vertical movement. Landing on a spike ends the attempt and restarts the level. Clicks and undo were not observed in the provided actions.
